title: Fix all findings from full-codebase read and ship to git
description: Epic: fix all 7 findings from the learn-codebase full read (missing proguard file, absent gradle wrapper, broken android_asset troubleshooting URI, dual header contracts, dead code, wrong androidTest order) and push to origin.
acceptance_criteria: ./gradlew --version works (wrapper 9.6.0 restored, committed); ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest passes; app/proguard-rules.pro exists and assembleDebug succeeds; troubleshooting guide opens from help dialog via bundled asset; CsvValidator.validateRecord validates primary Goodvibes headers and comma decimals are normalized with regression tests; androidTest asserts Date,Weight,Fat,BMI order; all work committed and pushed to origin main

title: Restore Gradle wrapper 9.6.0 from local cache
description: gradle/wrapper/ is missing entirely (gradlew exists but no jar/properties). Gradle 9.6.0-bin dist is already cached in ~/.gradle/wrapper/dists. Copy gradle-wrapper.jar from the cached distribution, write gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties with distributionUrl gradle-9.6.0-bin.zip, ensure .gitignore lines 34-35 (gradle-wrapper.jar, gradle/) do not exclude the wrapper from VCS, commit the wrapper.
acceptance_criteria: ./gradlew --version prints Gradle 9.6.0; ./gradlew help succeeds; wrapper jar and properties tracked by git

title: Create app/proguard-rules.pro
description: app/build.gradle:31 references proguard-rules.pro with minifyEnabled true but the file does not exist - assembleRelease fails. Create the file with minimal safe keep rules (no reflection-sensitive code in app, but keep data classes used via LiveData if needed).
acceptance_criteria: app/proguard-rules.pro exists and is committed; ./gradlew assembleDebug still succeeds; lintDebug reports no new issues

title: Fix troubleshooting guide delivery in help dialog
description: MainActivity.openTroubleshootingGuide fires ACTION_VIEW on file:///android_asset/docs/complete-troubleshooting-guide.md but app/src/main/assets/ does not exist - the guide lives only in repo docs/ and never ships in the APK; every tap lands in catch and shows a toast. Fix: copy the guide into app/src/main/assets/docs/, render it in-app (WebView inside AlertDialog), remove the broken ACTION_VIEW intent.
acceptance_criteria: Guide file present under app/src/main/assets/docs/ and bundled in APK; help dialog Troubleshooting button opens the guide content in-app; no ACTION_VIEW on android_asset URI remains; strings en+ru updated if new UI strings added

title: Unify record validation contract and remove dead code
description: CsvValidator.validateRecord validates ALTERNATIVE headers (Дата/Вес (кг)) while production rows carry PRIMARY headers (Время измерения/Вес(кг)); real Goodvibes rows always report missing fields and inject ignored defaults. Rewire validateRecord to the primary contract (keep alternative support), wire CsvFieldMapper.normalizeWeight/Bmi/Fat into RecordProcessor so comma decimals are normalized (currently a 79,65 weight fails GarminCsvSchema and kills the whole generation), remove dead kg-to-lbs branch in mapToGarminFormat and unused createFieldMapping, fix GarminCsvSchemaTest comma-decimal test to assert normalized output. CLAUDE.md mandate: parsing/normalization changes MUST come with unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: validateRecord accepts primary Goodvibes headers and validates date/weight/bmi/fat values; comma-decimal input 79,65 produces 79.65 in output CSV; kg-to-lbs dead branch removed; all unit tests pass including new regression tests; RecordProcessorTest expectations updated for primary contract

title: Fix androidTest EndToEndIntegrationTest column order
description: androidTest EndToEndIntegrationTest (in ShareIntentTest.kt) asserts header Date,Weight,BMI,Fat but GarminCsvSchema emits Date,Weight,Fat,BMI; test data uses alternative headers Дата,Вес unlike real Goodvibes input. Align assertions with the schema contract and align test input headers with the primary contract.
acceptance_criteria: androidTest asserts Body + Date,Weight,Fat,BMI order consistent with GarminCsvSchema; test header constants match primary Goodvibes headers; lintDebug clean

title: Final review gate, merge and push to origin
description: After T2-T5 complete: run full quality gates (testDebugUnitTest, lintDebug, assembleDebug), dispatch end-of-epic review suite (review-quality, security-scanner, test-effectiveness-analyst in parallel), dual final gate (autonomous-reviewer APPROVED + review-implementation PASS), remediate if needed, then merge branch to main and push all commits + .beads to origin.
acceptance_criteria: All 3 specialized reviews run and findings remediated; autonomous-reviewer returns APPROVED and review-implementation returns PASS; git push origin main succeeds and includes all epic commits
